lede: The loudest signal on Wednesday came from a single GitHub repository. morluto/rea, a tool for reverse engineering software with AI agents, picked up roughly 54,700 stars in one day, far ahead of anything else on the trending list. The one topic the feeds actually shared was smaller and stranger: a Shanghai Rolex Masters match between Botic van de Zandschulp and Rafael Jodar that surfaced on both Google Trends and Polymarket at once. Elsewhere attention split along familiar lines, with RJ Mitte topping Wikipedia at about 2.1 million views and Counter-Strike 2 holding the top of Steam at over 1.2 million concurrent players.
